validity.recommendation: verify LengthKnownKm 1177 per string against a Transgaz Moscow/Kubangazprom document; uk.wikipedia gives 1773 km for the whole system
validity.researcher_notes: Real and correctly classified: Transgaz Moscow (Wayback 2024) lists Краснодарский Край — Серпухов I and II нитка as operating trunk mains; Rostov UMG history confirms two Ду-1020 strings. P1470/P5551 are two real strings, not a duplicate, but both carry an identical 1177 km and 1961 start. No source states 1177 km; uk.wikipedia gives 1773 km system total (possible transposition). Operator on sheet is Gazprom PJSC while the operating entity is Gazprom Transgaz Moscow (flag).

fills.researcher_notes: String I: Transgaz Moscow lists it among магистральные газопроводы (natural gas transmission). Transgaz Moscow Voronezh LPUMG page (Wayback 2024-11-15; hand-read): lists '7 магистральных газопроводов ... МГ Краснодарский Край — Серпухов I нитка; МГ Краснодарский Край — Серпухов II нитка' in the Северный Кавказ — Центр corridor. Name confirmed by hand (verifier substring screen missed the dash/nbsp variant).

Pipeline name 'Краснодарский край-Серпухов' (Rostov UMG history) and uk.wikipedia 'від Ростова до ... Серпухова' place the ends in Krasnodar Krai and Serpukhov (Moscow Oblast). Endpoint names are name-derived; no document gives a coordinate. Rostov UMG history (ucit-rostov.narod.ru, Gazprom Rostov UMG 50-year history): '1957-1966 гг. ... две нитки Ду-1020мм газопровода «Краснодарский край-Серпухов»'; '1967-1976 ... Продолжилось строительство второй очереди газопровода «Краснодарский край-Серпухов»'. Verifier OK.

Both Transgaz Moscow LPUMG pages (Wayback 2024-11/12) show the string operated by Gazprom Transgaz Moscow, a wholly owned Gazprom PJSC subsidiary, inside the Gazprom site. No page states ownership in words, so this supports owner only by inference; low. Not independent (one origin).

'магистральный газопровод' (trunk main) in the Северный Кавказ — Центр corridor, operated by LPUMG of Transgaz Moscow; transmission confirmed. Transgaz Moscow Voronezh LPUMG page (Wayback 2024-11-15; hand-read): lists '7 магистральных газопроводов ... МГ Краснодарский Край — Серпухов I нитка; МГ Краснодарский Край — Серпухов II нитка' in the Северный Кавказ — Центр corridor. Name confirmed by hand (verifier substring screen missed the dash/nbsp variant).

Worklist value is the same for both strings (1177 km); no source found giving 1177 km for either string. Searched Transgaz Moscow LPUMG pages, ru/uk Wikipedia, Rostov UMG history, energybase (geo-blocked), zakupki360 (JS shell). uk.wikipedia gives 1773 km for the whole Krasnodar-Serpukhov system of pipes (both strings plus loops), not per string: 1177 may be a digit transposition of 1773 or a per-route figure; flagged in validity, value kept.

String I still listed as operated by Transgaz Moscow in Wayback captures of 2024-11-15 (Voronezh LPUMG) and 2024-12-12 (Elets LPUMG: 'Краснодарский край — Серпухов 1 и 2 нитка' under 'надежная эксплуатация'). Same operator origin; medium.

Rostov UMG history: two Ду-1020 strings. A search snippet of zakupki360 tender 32312501324 (page is a JS shell, unverifiable, NOT cited) labels the 1st string section Ду 820 mm. uk.wikipedia says ~1000 mm first string. Single citable source; second source searched (Transgaz pages, Wikipedia) found only the approximate 1000 mm. Rostov UMG history (ucit-rostov.narod.ru, Gazprom Rostov UMG 50-year history): '1957-1966 гг. ... две нитки Ду-1020мм газопровода «Краснодарский край-Серпухов»'; '1967-1976 ... Продолжилось строительство второй очереди газопровода «Краснодарский край-Серпухов»'. Verifier OK.

1961 = first additional Rostov-Serpukhov string (uk.wikipedia); ru.wikipedia puts I and II string in the early 1960s. Consistent with recorded 1961 for string I. uk.wikipedia: 1961 additional Rostov-Serpukhov string ~1000 mm, 1965 second string Rostov-Serpukhov; system total pipeline length 1773 km. Verifier OK (name + 1961/1965/1773).

Sheet operator is 'Gazprom PJSC'; the documents show the day-to-day operator is Gazprom Transgaz Moscow (Voronezh/Elets/Tula/Serpukhov LPUMG). Staged against the recorded value with the subsidiary noted; flag, not restaged (brief). Transgaz Moscow Voronezh LPUMG page (Wayback 2024-11-15; hand-read): lists '7 магистральных газопроводов ... МГ Краснодарский Край — Серпухов I нитка; МГ Краснодарский Край — Серпухов II нитка' in the Северный Кавказ — Центр corridor. Name confirmed by hand (verifier substring screen missed the dash/nbsp variant).
